Definition: Whether the country has established or is actively developing an instant/real-time payment system (IPS/RTP) that enables digital payments with near-instant settlement (typically within seconds), available 24/7/365. This includes both bank-led and mobile money interoperability systems.
Comments: BCEAO’s regional instant payment platform PI‑SPI (Plateforme Interopérable du Système de Paiement Instantané) was launched on 30 Sept 2025 for all eight WAEMU/UEMOA countries; the official participant list shows Guinea‑Bissau has at least four institutions (BDU, Coris Bank, Ecobank, Orabank) authorized to offer PI‑SPI services to the public.
